units.source_text: 在遥远的山巅上空，还淡淡地残留着晚霞的余晖。

en.t: High above the distant mountain peaks, the afterglow of sunset still lingered faintly.

units.source_text: 透过车窗玻璃看见的景物轮廓，退到远方，却没有消逝，但已经黯然失色了。

en.t: The outlines of the scenery seen through the train window receded into the distance and had not vanished, but their color had already dimmed.

units.source_text: 尽管火车继续往前奔驰，在他看来，山野那平凡的姿态越是显得更加平凡了。

en.t: Though the train kept rushing ahead, to him the ordinary forms of the mountains and fields seemed only more ordinary.

units.source_text: 由于什么东西都不十分惹他注目，他内心反而好像隐隐地存在着一股巨大的感情激流。

en.t: Because nothing especially caught his eye, there seemed instead to be a vast, dim current of feeling hidden within him.

units.source_text: 这自然是由于镜中浮现出姑娘的脸的缘故。

en.t: This, of course, was because the girl's face had appeared in the mirror.

units.source_text: 只有身影映在窗玻璃上的部分，遮住了窗外的暮景，

en.t: Only the part where her figure was reflected in the window glass blocked the evening scene outside,

units.source_text: 然而，景色却在姑娘的轮廓周围不断地移动，使人觉得姑娘的脸也像是透明的。

en.t: yet the scenery kept moving around the outline of the girl, making her face seem transparent as well.

units.source_text: 是不是真的透明呢？这是一种错觉。因为从姑娘面影后面不停地掠过的暮景，仿佛是从她脸的前面流过。定睛一看，却又扑朔迷离。

en.t: Was it really transparent? It was an illusion, for the evening scene constantly sweeping past behind the girl's face seemed to flow across its front. When he looked closely, it became elusive again.

units.source_text: 车厢里也不太明亮。窗玻璃上的映像不像真的镜子那样清晰了。

en.t: The inside of the carriage was not very bright either. The reflection in the window glass was no longer as clear as in a real mirror.

units.source_text: 反光没有了。这使岛村看入了神，他渐渐地忘却了镜子的存在，只觉得姑娘好像漂浮在流逝的暮景之中。

en.t: The glare was gone. This drew Shimamura in, and little by little he forgot the existence of the mirror, feeling only that the girl seemed to be floating in the passing evening scene.
